result:
I've written the round-62 task, and the decision is **CONTINUE**. C passed round 61 with no bugs, so the next stage of the Grid/Snap feature (SRW-14, stage 4c) starts. I didn't touch any app source.

**What C's round-61 evidence closed:**
- C-R60-01 (focus left the grid menu after a press on its edge or divider).
- C-R60-02 (a held, auto-repeating key released the dismiss-click swallow).
- ROOT-R50-58-L1 (a vertical scroll during Follow didn't close the menu).
- A-R60-REVIEW-BLUR-CAPTURE-TEST (missing blur test).

Gates: 89 files / 1556 tests, tsc 0, `npm run verify` rc 0. Stage 4b is complete. I archived the old task as `tasks/round-61.md` (identical copy) and saved copies of the planning files before editing them.

**Round 62: a selected group snaps to clip edges** (decision D-29z27, `current-task.md`)
- **Behaviour:** when a group of clips is dragged, the clip being dragged (the anchor) snaps to the grid line or to another clip's start or end. The other selected clips' own edges are never targets.
- **Unchanged:**
  - when the grid line wins, the result is exactly today's;
  - when the nearest edge would push a group member into a neighbour, it falls back to today's grid behaviour;
  - Snap off, Alt, Shift and keyboard nudge behave as before.
- **Files A may change:** `grid.ts` (one new helper), the group-move part of `ArrangementClip.tsx`, two test files, and the new doc 055. Everything else is frozen by a 418-file hash list, and the protected auth/purchase files are untouched.
- **Tests:** the old group test (CM10) is rewritten and 13 are added, giving 89 / 1569. They cover snapping by start and by end, member edges being ignored, sub-millisecond exactness, the bounds fallback, the lane rule and Alt. They also commit two earlier probes as real tests: the Snap-off whole-millisecond start, and Shift pressed only on the last drag step. A must show 11 deliberate code mutations each fail a named test. I checked every expected value against the actual code and C's earlier probe output.
- **C checks in the browser:** group snapping by start and by end, member edges ignored, the bounds fallback, cross-lane moves, Alt and Snap off, and a real-audio playback check that the moved clip sounds at its new start. Plus regressions of single-clip moves, and the anonymous `/studio-lab` and purchase-protection check.

**Decisions to review:**
- **Stage 4c is split, not cut:** library drops snapping to clip edges are round 63. Nothing is labelled deferred.
- **C-R51-01 is closed by design, with no code change.** When a library item is dropped on a blocked spot, the red ghost text and no-drop cursor show the refusal during the drag; no message appears after release. Your transcript (`2.srt` 05:16ΓÇô07:53) doesn't ask for one. I put a line in the Tech Lead list in `feature-status.md`: if you want a message after release, it becomes a separate small task.
- **One limitation is recorded, not fixed:** if the dragged clip has a sub-millisecond start and the edge sits exactly on the grid line, the group can be refused where an exact join would work. Today's code behaves the same way. It is logged as GROUP-SUBMS-GRID-EDGE, and the demo assets aren't affected.

**For root:**
- **The backend (`:5199`) has been down since the machine restart.** Please start it before A. G62-3 needs it to re-confirm that a fake Bearer token gets 403 rather than the 500 seen on 10-19. `/studio-lab` itself works without it.
- **Ready to commit as interim units:** `cb12805` (rounds 50ΓÇô58) and rounds 59, 60 and 61. The publisher has never run, and starting it is the user's action.
- **Architecture checkpoint re-requested:** parts (a) to (c) have no answer yet. Part (d) is re-raised because A's round-61 code review found a duplicated Follow check. Root had already said "keep for now" on it. Rounds 62 and 63 don't wait for the answer.

The advisor was available and I called it twice, before and after writing. It found that I had wrongly said root never answered the architecture request, and I corrected that. Its other points (a missing report section, the Tech Lead line, recording the limitation) are applied. Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`: `current-task.md`, `b-round-61.md`, `b-next.json`, `feature-status.md`, `backlog.json` (version 64), and decision D-29z27 in `plan.md`.
